component_instructions.general: Use lucide-react for all icons. Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering. Use sonner for toasts.
component_instructions.role_switcher: A segmented control in the top bar. Smooth background slide animation when switching between 'Student' and 'Faculty' modes.
component_instructions.aiah_companion: AIAH is contextual. Click the dock icon to expand a glassmorphism side panel (w-96) on the right. Content should relate to the current page (e.g., 'Analyze this portfolio' or 'Suggest next module').
component_instructions.curriculum_builder: Implement using HTML5 drag and drop or a library like dnd-kit. Visuals should resemble Figma/Notion with technical dark mode aesthetics, 1px borders, and monospaced properties.
component_instructions.ecosystem_nav: Permanent left nav. Active states should have a subtle #E23A25 left border glow and text color highlight.
component_instructions.course_tiles: Cinematic. 16:9 ratio. Dark gradient overlay at the bottom to ensure text readability. Hover state slightly scales up the background image and reveals a 'Play' or 'Continue' icon.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the dark #050505 background passes WCAG AA minimums. Use primary text #F8F9FA for high emphasis, #A1A1AA for medium emphasis.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring, e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/50 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling framer-motion animations if set.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements (links, buttons, inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-hub-link', data-testid='role-switcher').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT use generic gradient backgrounds.
Do NOT center align text globally.
Create depth using the glass_card_recipe and drop shadows.
Ensure the film grain overlay is applied globally to the main layout for a cinematic feel.
Use Playfair Display for Learning Mode headings to give an editorial MasterClass vibe.
Use JetBrains Mono for Creation Mode data and labels to mimic professional studio software like Logic Pro or Figma.
Ensure ecosystem hubs (ANCRLAB, INHEIRA, etc.) have distinct launch animations when clicked.
